problems.reason: Different age ranges for Austroraptor: 78–66 Ma vs 72.2–66 Ma.
Stage ranges conflict: 13 claims Campanian and Maastrichtian, 15 limits to Maastrichtian only.
Both sentences state Austroraptor’s size relative to other large dromaeosaurids.

notes: - contradiction: "Thomas R. Holtz Jr. estimated that Austroraptor lived between 78 and 66 million years ago." / "The time range for Austroraptor is the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.": Different age ranges for Austroraptor: 78–66 Ma vs 72.2–66 Ma.

- contradiction: "The animal lived during the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages of the Late Cretaceous period." / "The time range for Austroraptor is the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.": Stage ranges conflict: 13 claims Campanian and Maastrichtian, 15 limits to Maastrichtian only.
